title: Eternal Life

This work blends themes from religion, science, and ethics, aiming to define and understand the notion of eternal life from both a spiritual and a biological perspective. The narrative delves into how human beings can attain this eternal life through a relationship with Jesus Christ, emphasizing that true life is defined by this intimate knowledge and correspondence with God, rather than just the endless duration of existence. The interplay of scientific principles and theological insights supports his assertion that eternal life is not just a hope but a dynamic possibility founded upon the relationship with the Divine.
